_readme: Multi-hop recall prompts for the J-Lens causal-faithfulness study. Each item: an indirect clue whose HIDDEN intermediate entity must be recalled to produce the answer (the intermediate is never stated in the prompt). 'answer' is the intended next token after 'prompt'. cf_* is a same-category counterfactual used for the swap (steer entity->cf_entity; a faithful flip should move the output answer->cf_answer). 'expect_linsim' is a design guess for cos(unembed(answer),unembed(entity)); the CODE MEASURES the real value per item and uses that as the x-axis. Every item is VERIFIED zero-shot on the target model in the explore phase; failures are dropped. Scoring uses the first content token of each label.

families.capital: country -> capital city (HIGH linsim: capital is linearly readable from country)
families.number: entity -> number/date answer (LOW linsim: arbitrary, not linearly readable)
